messages:
maya: FYI customer report — users hitting 400 from GitHub SSO during callback. Error in our logs: "state_mismatch". Started after yesterday's identity-proxy change :confused:
jon: Can you paste the raw callback URL they saw?
maya: customer sent: `https://app.acme.example.com/auth/callback?code=xxxx&state=abc+defGHI`
ingrid: hmm the `+` in the state looks suspect. Many providers expect `%2B` not literal plus if something rewrites it. Did we touch query handling in the proxy?
ashwin: I rolled a tiny nginx change that normalized URLs (proxy_pass without preserving args). That can convert `+` -> space in some setups. Reproduced locally by hitting our proxy:
```
# repro
curl -v "https://id.redwood.test/cb?code=xxx&state=abc+defGHI"
# upstream sees: state=abc defGHI
```
jon: when upstream sees a space the state comparison fails -> `state_mismatch`. Good catch.
maya: customer said the failure happens mostly on Android in-app browser and on their corporate proxy.
ingrid: Android WebView sometimes double-decodes or handles `+` differently when redirecting to custom scheme. Combined with our proxy rewrite could explain the narrow repro.
ashwin: quick mitigation: encode `+` to `%2B` on redirect generation at our auth layer if possible. But for a short-term fix I'm going to change the proxy config to preserve the raw querystring and avoid any `rewrite`/`normalize` step.
jon: also add defensive check: treat space and `%20`/`+` normalization consistently when comparing state (but log if we had to normalize).
maya: customer wants a timeline and workaround. Can we provide a temporary redirect rule they can apply on their proxy to re-encode the state param?
ashwin: yes, example nginx snippet I can give them:
```
# ensure querystring passed literally
location /auth/callback {
  proxy_pass http://auth-upstream$request_uri; # preserves querystring as-is
}
# OR re-encode plus to %2B in rewrite
if ($args ~* "state=(.*)\+(.*)") {
  set $args_new "state=$1%2B$2";
  return 302 $scheme://$host$request_uri?$args_new;
}
```
ingrid: also logging note — add a header `X-Observed-State: "$arg_state"` for a minute so we can see what proxies upstream are sending in production (don’t leave long term).
maya: I told the customer: 1) try using an encoded state (workaround for mobile), 2) we will change proxy config and deploy a hotfix to preserve querystring. They asked for ETA.
support-bot: deploy triggered: identity-proxy hotfix branch -> staging (build 4123). :rocket:
deploy-bot: staging deploy success (4123) — rolling to canary next.
jon: after canary we should run an internal test: open Android WebView -> perform GitHub SSO -> confirm final upstream sees `%2B` in state param.
ashwin: will follow up with PR link and config diff, and I'll post the exact nginx snippet for their ops team.
maya: thanks — I'll update the ticket and push the workaround steps. :thumbsup:
jon: small follow-up: add a unit test in our auth library that round-trips encode/decode for `+`, `%2B`, and spaces so this doesn't regress.
ashwin: added to my TODO.
maya: closing loop here, will re-open if customer still sees mismatch after canary.
